dogecoin.text: 'Bitcoin hit a record high of $64,754 apiece, ether traded as high as $2,398 and dogecoin—the meme cryptocurrency created as a joke—surged 77% to $0.13. The rally in dogecoin came despite Coinbase not offering trading in it.' https://t.co/glSfkY0uPO

'Dogecoin serves no purpose, and unlike bitcoin, faces no limit on the number of coins that can exist. Each day, computers solve mathematical puzzles to unlock new coins. About 129.2 billion dogecoin were in circulation Monday, according to CoinDesk.' https://t.co/JRkNC86Zr3
